_meta.document: OpenAI Agentic Commerce product feed - INTERNAL DRAFT
_meta.do_not_submit_reason: One true blocker: price is REQUIRED and must be current, and no current-price source or update pipeline exists. Marketplace onboarding with OpenAI is also required to resolve marketplace_seller. Image format and availability are NOT blockers - see _field_notes.
_meta.target_feed_format: JSONL (one record per line). This file is pretty-printed JSON for review only; the emitted feed must be JSONL.

record.title: JUMVI Toss & Catch Game Set - 4 Hand-Strap Paddles, 4 Sticky Balls, 36 Guided Missions, Ages 3-12
record.description: JUMVI Toss & Catch is a 2-4 player toss-and-catch activity set for ages 3-12. The box contains 4 hand-strap EVA paddles, 4 sticky toss-and-catch balls, a mesh carry bag and a QR Mission Card. Scanning the QR Mission Card opens the JUMVI Mission Hub in a mobile browser with 36 Guided Missions across 6 skill packs. No app download and no signup are required.
record.product_category: Toys & Games > Outdoor Play > Toss & Catch Games

_field_notes.item_id: Stable neutral internal ID. Per spec, item_id must stay stable and must never be reused. No better-established internal ID exists in the repository.
_field_notes.title: 97 characters, within the 150-character limit. Front-loads brand and product type, then the verified contents and age range. No superlatives or promotional padding.
_field_notes.description: Plain factual text, 358 characters, well within the 5,000-character limit. Every claim traces to a verified field in product-truth.json.
_field_notes.url: The canonical homepage. jumvi.co has no product-detail route; the homepage IS the product page.
_field_notes.seller_name: SAY23 LLC is the brand owner and seller of record. This is not the marketplace name - see _marketplace_position below.
_field_notes.image_url: Set to the live production WebP full-set shot - the best existing canonical product image for a feed (4 paddles, 4 balls, mesh bag and printed box on white, 1400x1200). The spec says 'Use a direct image URL, such as a JPEG or PNG'; JPEG and PNG are examples and WebP is not documented as rejected. A high-quality JPEG derivative is staged at commerce/assets/jumvi-feed-main.jpg for defensive compatibility, future public path assets/jumvi-feed-main.jpg. Not deployed. Not a blocker.
_field_notes.availability: Set to 'unknown', which the spec explicitly accepts. This makes no stock claim and is honest while no automated stock source exists, so availability is NOT a discovery blocker. Automating it to a real in_stock / out_of_stock value via amazon_offer_source remains highly desirable.
_field_notes.price: UNRESOLVED and THE blocker. Required by the spec, must be current, and must use '<amount> <CURRENCY>' format e.g. '29.99 USD'. Must be injected at build time from a current verified source. Never hardcode and never reuse a cached value - a required-and-current field cannot be satisfied by a stale constant.
_field_notes.gtin: Omitted. No GTIN is verified. The spec validates the check digit, and an invented value would fail validation as well as being a false identity claim.
_field_notes.review_count: Omitted. Recommended by the spec for discovery, but JUMVI has no first-party review corpus. Amazon review data belongs to Amazon and is not republished.
_field_notes.sku_mpn: The spec has no sku or mpn field, so no mapping is emitted. Even if a compatible field existed, JUMVI-001 and JMV-TC-001 remain unresolved and must not be mapped - see identifiers.unresolved in product-truth.json.
_field_notes.is_eligible_search: Set true to request search/discovery eligibility. The spec documents this as a request flag that defaults to true; it is NOT a guarantee of display, ranking or inclusion. OpenAI makes no documented promise about visibility or placement.
_field_notes.is_eligible_checkout: Set false deliberately. Search/discovery and ChatGPT checkout are separate tracks; the current objective is discovery only. Enabling checkout is a separate decision with its own requirements (seller_tos among them).
_field_notes.seller_tos: jumvi.co publishes a privacy policy but no terms of service page. seller_tos is conditionally required for CHECKOUT eligibility, which is intentionally disabled. It is NOT a discovery blocker.
_field_notes.marketplace_seller: UNRESOLVED pending OpenAI feed setup. The spec documents it as 'Conditionally required for third-party marketplace offers; requires setup' and defines it as the marketplace where checkout occurs, kept distinct from the supplying seller_name. For JUMVI: seller_name is SAY23 LLC, checkout_location is Amazon US. The exact registered value must come from OpenAI during onboarding and must NOT be guessed.

_marketplace_position.situation: The physical product is sold on Amazon US (ASIN B0H16JPQCF) with SAY23 LLC as the seller. jumvi.co is a brand and product-information site with no cart and no checkout.
_marketplace_position.spec_support: SUPPORTED. The Stable product feed specification handles third-party marketplace offers directly. Verbatim: 'For a third-party seller, seller_name identifies that seller and marketplace_seller identifies the marketplace where checkout occurs.' marketplace_seller is documented as 'Conditionally required for third-party marketplace offers; requires setup', defined as 'Marketplace where checkout occurs. Keep distinct from the supplying seller_name.' Verified against https://developers.openai.com/commerce/specs/feed.md on 2026-09-12.
_marketplace_position.why_unresolved: marketplace_seller 'requires setup'. The exact registered marketplace value is assigned through OpenAI feed onboarding. Guessing a string such as 'Amazon' or 'amazon_us' would be inventing an identifier we have not been given.
_marketplace_position.action: Complete OpenAI feed setup / merchant onboarding and record the value OpenAI supplies, then emit it.
